description: Dependency-maintenance Lane A (KB-407, ADR-0015 wave 2): one deterministic collect sweep (KB-406) feeds a pure-jq classify step (deterministic buckets + consolidated one-carrier-per-module plan), a pure-jq route brief, a decision-adapter gate (proceed or hold; unconfident or undeclared choices hold), a rebase lane (gh pr update-branch with read-back) and a brokenbot-lane merge step (gated carrier merges + close-out of superseded PRs). Artifacts (inventory, classification, acts, merged) are written under the sweep root on the data lane.
